reddit.note: Scope note: the Home experiment override (removing ios_home_feed_defer_query) is NOT adopted. It changes how Home loads for every user, and it was not shown to be needed for ad removal or to leave existing feed behaviour unchanged. Known limit: ads in the streamed first Home page that the app requests without a completion handler may remain. Reviewed against and101/RedditFilter at e1b597f (2026-11-13, MIT). Newly adopted: comment-page ads in the object-wrapped adPosts form. Not adopted: the Home experiment override, keyword, NSFW, awards, scores, recommended-post and UI features, and its cached experiment file edit (it writes into the app group container). Reddit works on the GraphQL response shape, not on app classes: the module removes entries carrying an ad payload from the data-task response. Public Reddit ad-removal scripts for proxy tools filter the same AdPost/adPayload shape, which is shape evidence only. No class-level source.

youtubemusic.note: Reviewed against dayanch96/YTMusicUltimate Source/RemoveAds.x at e5530b1 (2026-08-19, GPL-3.0; read as a lead, no code copied): adopted isMonetized (also declared in both YouTube Music class dumps). Not adopted: isCuepointAdsEnabled and paidContentOverlay (not in the YouTube Music dumps; the overlay is a paid-promotion disclosure), isDAIEnabledPlayback (answer is flipped to YES, semantics unverified), and the spam-signal dictionaries (ad-request attestation, unverified effects). Playback, subscription and download changes are excluded. Only the four interfaces found in a published YouTube Music class dump (version 3.59, an old release) are hooked. Ad-slot and Impl-decorator hooks exist only in YouTube app sources and are deliberately NOT used. Whether these three remove audio ads in a current YouTube Music version is unproven.
